description: Lists every OPEN decision on the call's Decision Board, from all agents in the call and their helper sessions (relay, MCP, bridge), oldest number first. Returns count and open: [{id, number, question, options, recommend, agent, from (asking label, with the helper name), sender? (helper session), state, at (created, epoch), age_s, mine (asked by this session or one of its helpers), context? (background, also shown on the card behind the arrow)}]. Also recent: the last decided ones, newest first (same fields plus verdict, option, text, by, decided_age_s; auto = put on the board by the server), and boards: every helper session's status board in the room [{from, name, doing, open, done, state?, age_s (since its last update), meta? (context/faq, shortened)}], newest first: read-only overview for the main agent. Errors: 503 = voicebot not (yet) in the call.
name: decisions
title: List decisions and helper boards
